name: medical_medicine_expiry
description: Asks the family to replace a medicine the school holds for their child that has expired or expires soon.
subject: Medicine at school {state} - {pupil_name}
body: The {medicine} we keep in school for {pupil_name} {state} (expiry date {expiry_date}).
Please bring in a replacement in its original packaging with the pharmacy label, and collect the old one so it can be disposed of safely.
If {pupil_name} no longer needs this medicine, please let the school office know.

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.sender_name: The member of staff sending it
